cards.effect: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards.

attacks.name: Turbo Bolt
attacks.effect: Attach 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.effect: This attack’s damage isn’t affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on your opponent’s Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flash Ray
attacks.effect: During your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.

attacks.name: Land’s Pulse
attacks.effect: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Rising Fist
attacks.effect: Discard an Energy attached to your opponent’s Active Pokémon.

cards.effect: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Trainer card you find there (except for Trainers’ Mail) and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
